question: Which ministry launched the KCC Ghar Ghar Abhiyaan in September 2023?

options.text: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
Ministry of Women and Child Development
Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs

solution:
The correct answer is __**Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare** launched the KCC Ghar Ghar Abhiyaan in September 2023.
 
• This initiative aims to promote the distribution and usage of Kisan Credit Cards (KCC) among farmers to ensure they have access to timely credit for their agricultural needs.
 
• The KCC scheme provides farmers with adequate and timely credit support from the banking system under a single window for their cultivation and other needs.
 
• The campaign is part of the government’s effort to enhance the financial inclusion of farmers and improve their economic stability.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Kisan Credit Card (KCC)** scheme was introduced in 1998 to provide short-term credit to farmers.
 
• The scheme aims to meet the comprehensive credit requirements of the agriculture sector by giving farmers the flexibility to purchase agricultural inputs and draw cash for their production needs.
 
• As of recent updates, the scheme has been expanded to cover livestock, fisheries, and other allied activities, ensuring broader coverage and benefit to the rural agricultural community.
 
• The KCC Ghar Ghar Abhiyaan will include awareness campaigns, door-to-door visits, and collaboration with local banks to facilitate the issuance of KCCs.
